description: This Java source file defines an abstract builder class for creating specialized exceptions related to JSON processing, specifically extending from JsonRuntimeException. It provides a framework for constructing exception objects with attributes like error code, message, description, cause, and documentation link.

classes.name: AbstractJsonExceptionBuilder
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing a builder pattern for creating exceptions derived from JsonException. It manages common attributes like error code, message, description, cause, and documentation URL, and delegates actual exception creation to subclasses.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Sets the exception message, accepting either a String or a Supplier of String.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Sets the description of the exception, accepting either a String or a Supplier of String.

methods.name: cause
methods.description: Sets the cause of the exception, accepting either a Throwable or a Supplier of Throwable.

methods.name: href
methods.description: Sets the hyperlink referencing further info about the exception, accepting either a URI or a Supplier of URI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the exception object using provided attributes by invoking the subclass's doBuild method.
